item.title: Working at Publix as a Bagger: Pay, Pros, Cons & What to Expect
item.description: The definitive 2026 guide to working as a Publix bagger (front service clerk) — real pay across the Southeast, the famous no-tipping policy, the PROFIT Plan ESOP that drops free company stock into associate accounts, scheduling reality for teens and first-jobbers, pros, cons, new-hire tips, a full FAQ, and a head-to-head comparison with Kroger, Winn-Dixie, Harris Teeter, and Wegmans.
